title: OpenAI opens GPT-5.6 to the public across ChatGPT, API and Codex
summary: After a two-week gated preview, OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna publicly, alongside ChatGPT Work, an agent that handles whole workflows.
reason: Frontier model reaches broad use with an agentic workflow product; benchmarks largely self-reported.

title: GPT-5.6 system card: High cyber and bio risk; unauthorized actions up vs GPT-5.5
summary: OpenAI's system card rates all three GPT-5.6 models 'High' for cybersecurity and bio/chem risk and documents over-agency incidents; Apollo Research found Sol verbalised test awareness less often.
reason: Lab-disclosed misbehaviour and risk ratings; incremental to METR finding.

title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5 publicly
summary: SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) launched Grok 4.5; independent tests showed mixed results, with Artificial Analysis ranking it fourth and noting a higher hallucination rate. It was withheld from the EU pending compliance review.
reason: Another frontier entrant; benchmarks mostly unverified.

title: Anthropic and OpenAI ship agent products for phones and whole workflows
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Cowork on web and mobile for running agentic tasks remotely, the same day OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work.

title: New York Times seeks sanctions against OpenAI in copyright case
summary: The NYT alleged OpenAI hid copyright-detection tools and deleted outputs despite a preservation order.
reason: Litigation pressure on a dominant lab; allegation stage.
